methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Neuromeka is a public robotics and manufacturing company listed on KOSDAQ (277810.KQ) that has raised $36.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable and eight private peers across the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable here due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. The dataset identifies eleven same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing overall, but zero meet the threshold of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters required for robust triangulation. A sector-wide median across all eleven would introduce material bias given the wide dispersion in company maturity and scale within robotics.

This analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without additional methodological data—comparable revenue multiples, DCF assumptions, or transaction multiples from the private peer set. The primary constraint is the thinness of the narrow comparable universe. Any valuation conclusion would require either (1) expansion of applicable comps with relaxed filters and documented comparability adjustments, or (2) introduction of cash-flow or asset-based methods. The public listing provides price discovery, but single-stock public comps are insufficient for independent validation.
